independence_note: Artifact and membership binding only. The producer's source safety is Astra's independent review; I wrote the adapter.
verdict: BOUND: the T1 KC is the native001 KC with exactly one member substituted. Its PDM1SPIHID is the trackpad-enumeration SDK bundle 2f2e4557 (output 1pc572bd), not keyboard SDK005. All other 48 non-kernel members are byte-identical to native001. PDSerialHID and PDDARTSurvey are absent.

checks.derivation: Versus cqvv6dn4: one added inputDrv, gkri9y75 (the trackpad SDK derivation, output 1pc572bd), and exactly one buildPhase line changed, at the same position: '-kext "/nix/store/l3kqr9zw...-PDM1SPIHID.kext"' (SDK005 copy) becomes '-kext "/nix/store/1pc572bd.../PDM1SPIHID.kext"'. Nothing else changed.
checks.membership: 50 fileset entries in the same order as native001: exactly one org.puredarwin.driver.PDM1SPIHID, no PDSerialHID, no PDDARTSurvey. IOHIDFamily and IOGOPFramebuffer are present (unchanged entries).
checks.bytes: 48 of the 49 non-kernel entries have byte-identical __TEXT/__DATA_CONST/__DATA and the same vmaddr, including the rev002 IOHIDFamily and PDKeyStore (no shift: PDM1SPIHID kept its segment sizes and address). The kernel changes only in one 16-byte block of its load-command header.
checks.pdm1spihid_binding: In the KC's PDM1SPIHID entry, __text, __cstring, __const, __stubs, __stub_helper and __unwind_info are byte-identical to bundle 2f2e4557. Only linked data differs (__got 12 words, __data 8 words). Against SDK005 (4d7aa91f) the same entry differs in size (__text 34364 vs 31820, __cstring 3303 vs 2728, __unwind_info 200 vs 180) and stubs, so it is not the keyboard binary.
checks.strings: The KC contains 'pdm1trackpadenum' and 'PDM1TrackpadEnumerationV1' (absent in native001), keeps the rev002 'BSD wait refused' string, and has no 'PDSerialHID: listening' or 'pddartsurvey'.

notes.text: With host eebf8bb8 the packet must carry the exact trackpad_enumeration_experiment (no DART key). A boot of this KC without 'pdm1trackpadenum=1' has no keyboard driver (probe declines), so the native inventory would be BLOCKED 77. That fails closed, as noted in trackpad-host-revision-review.json TH1.

scope: Read-only: nix derivations and outputs, KC fileset entries/segments/sections, bundle sections. No builds, source changes, SSH or hardware.
